header.title: TriBERT
header.tagline: A Triplet-Based Approach for Visual Question Answering

left: Visual question answering (VQA) is a challenging task that requires models to understand both visual and textual information. Traditional approaches often struggle with complex queries that demand deep reasoning about the image content. In this work, we propose TriBERT, a triplet-based approach for VQA that leverages the power of transformer architectures to capture intricate relationships between images and questions.
